ryan: heads up—perf drop after hf->safetensors conversion for qwen-7b. throughput down ~18% on mixed-length loads. root msg ts 1729456789.

mia: which artifact/commit?

ryan: artifact 9b3a2f, converted this morning. baseline: 975 req/s @ seq=256; after: 800 req/s @ seq=768. profiler points to kernel selection churn.

alex: paste kernel_selector trace?

ryan: trace excerpt:
[kernel_selector] scored kernels: matmul_f32: 0.84, matmul_f16_qk_opt: 0.88
[kernel_selector] choose matmul_f16_qk_opt for seq>600
[batcher] merged micro-batch: short=128,long=768 -> adjusted window
[kernel_selector] hysteresis timer reset
[kv_cache] evict_pages count++ -> miss_rate 0.03 -> 0.29
[kernel_selector] immediate re-eval -> switch back to matmul_f32

alex: swapping like that during a single request is bad. Why is hysteresis not holding?

sam: could be model metadata mismatch. converter might have inferred head size incorrectly which changes our kernel scoring function.

mia: did converter include 'axes' and 'num_attention_heads' in safetensors metadata? we had a prior bug where axes were missing and we guessed.

ryan: safetensors meta from artifact:
{"shape":{"k_proj.weight":[4096,2048]},"dtype":"f16"}
# no axes, no num_attention_heads, no rotary_scale

convert-bot: conversion succeeded; warning: "axes missing, shapes inferred"

alex: inferring is brittle. If n_heads inferred wrong, head_dim flips (64 vs 128) and the kernel scoring moves.

sam: i ran a quick infer script: for model size and qkv dims we expect n_heads=32 but inferred 16 -> headsize doubled instead of halved.

ryan: that explains why the selector prefers f16 kernel for long sequences but some tensors previously allocated for f32 path cause memory planner churn when we flip -> batcher flushes kv -> miss spike.

mia: action items:
- converter: require axes + num_attention_heads in metadata; fail by default or write a .meta.json that downstream can trust
- kernel-selector: strengthen hysteresis: tie to request scope and add short grace after micro-batch merges (e.g., 200ms) to prevent flipflop
- batcher: implement soft binning by sequence quantiles to avoid mixing very short and very long in same micro-batch
- perf-ci: add a regression gate: reject conversion that causes >10% throughput regression for same workload

alex: also add a runtime check: when loading model, validate head_dim * num_attention_heads == qkv_dim and warn/fail if mismatch. unit tests for hfparse.

sam: i'll add a synthetic test to simulate mixed-length micro-batches and assert kernel_selector chooses consistent kernel for the duration of request.

ryan: can we mitigate immediately? fallback routing to previous artifact or enforce matmul_f32 for this artifact until fixed.

alex: i pinned old artifact and rolled back traffic. infra-bot scheduled rollback to 3f1d222. ETA 8m.

convert-bot: opened ticket RW-7890 "safetensors meta missing axes -> conversion should not silently infer" (https://redwood.atlassian/RW-7890)

infra-bot: rollback initiated, artifact 9b3a2f -> drained, 3f1d222 serving. will monitor.

mia: nice. please attach the profiler + small repro (docker + run script) to RW-7890.

ryan: will do. prepping minimal docker image and perf harness. last_message_ts=1729456889
